anton_ivanov.name: Anton Ivanov
anton_ivanov.text: Anton! Head of Belobog Industries' construction team, at your service.

billy_kid.name: Billy Kid
billy_kid.text: By my hand, this endless conflict shall meet its end!

corin_wickes.name: Corin Wickes
corin_wickes.text: Uh... Excuse me... Is there something I can do for you? Anything at all?

ellen_joe.name: Ellen Joe
ellen_joe.text: I've been waiting for you, Master.

evelyn_chevalier.name: Evelyn Chevalier
evelyn_chevalier.text: I'm Evelyn. Looking forward to a pleasant partnership.

asaba_harumasa.name: Asaba Harumasa
asaba_harumasa.text: Leave it all to me. You just sit back and worry on my behalf.

hugo_vlad.name: Hugo Vlad
hugo_vlad.text: Take a guess. Heads? Tails? Or something else entirely?

nekomiya_mana.name: Nekomiya Mana
nekomiya_mana.text: Fine! I guess I'll join you for some fun!

seed.name: Seed
seed.text: Yoh-hoh~ Obol Squad's heavy weapons specialist, Seed, has arrived~

soldier_0_anby.name: Soldier 0 - Anby
soldier_0_anby.text: Captain Anby, of Silver Squad. Does this new title mean double the pay?

soldier_11.name: Soldier 11
soldier_11.text: Soldier 11, reporting for duty. Ready for action.

ye_shunguang.name: Ye Shunguang
ye_shunguang.text: Ye Shunguang of Yunkui Summit, heeding your summons!

zhu_yuan.name: Zhu Yuan
zhu_yuan.text: Leader of Public Security's Criminal Investigation Team, Zhu Yuan, standing by.

alice_thymefield.name: Alice Thymefield
alice_thymefield.text: Alice Thymefield. On behalf of the Thymefield Family, I extend my regards to you.

burnice.name: Burnice White
burnice.text: Mixologist Burnice, so glad to see ya!

grace_howard.name: Grace Howard
grace_howard.text: What's up? Need some technical support?

jane_doe.name: Jane Doe
jane_doe.text: Criminology specialist, Jane. Pleasure to meet you.

hoshimi_miyabi.name: Hoshimi Miyabi
hoshimi_miyabi.text: Greetings. I am Hoshimi Miyabi, Chief of Section 6.

piper_wheel.name: Piper Wheel
piper_wheel.text: Heh... What can this little old trucker do for ya'?

vivian_banshee.name: Vivian Banshee
vivian_banshee.text: Let me make this clear in advance. I'm only here for Lord Phaethon.

tsukishiro_yanagi.name: Tsukishiro Yanagi
tsukishiro_yanagi.text: Hello. I'm Tsukishiro Yanagi, Deputy Chief of Section 6.

banyue.name: Banyue
banyue.text: I stand as a barrier, no calamity shall pass. You're safe under my guard.

komano_manato.name: Komano Manato
komano_manato.text: Need my help? We're all friends, no need to be so formal.

starlight_billy.name: Billy Kid
starlight_billy.text: By my hand, this endless conflict shall meet its end!

yidhari.name: Yidhari
yidhari.text: I look forward to the story we're about to write together.

yixuan.name: Yixuan
yixuan.text: I'm the 13th generation High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit, Yixuan.

anby_demara.name: Anby Demara
anby_demara.text: Anby, of the Cunning Hares, in position.

dialyn.name: Dialyn
dialyn.text: Rep 2493, Dialyn! Happy to assist with your request!

ju_fufu.name: Ju Fufu
ju_fufu.text: I'm Ju Fufu, disciple of Yunkui Summit! Yeah, that sounded pretty impressive, right?

koleda_belobog.name: Koleda Belobog
koleda_belobog.text: Hey you! Quit staring at me like I'm a kid!

lighter.name: Lighter
lighter.text: Have you heard of the red scarf?

von_lycaon.name: Von Lycaon
von_lycaon.text: Master's wish is my most sacred mission.

pulchra_fellini.name: Pulchra Fellini
pulchra_fellini.text: Of course! If the pay is good, why not?

qingyi.name: Qingyi
qingyi.text: Automaton Qingyi. Eager to learn from your wisdom.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.text: Trigger, sniper of Obol Squad. Reporting for duty.

astra_yao.name: Astra Yao
astra_yao.text: I've been recognized. So nice to meet you!

lucia.name: Lucia
lucia.text: Ready for an adventure in the Hollow? Let's go right now!

lucy.name: Lucy
lucy.text: Esteemed Proxy, good day. You may call me Lady Lucy.

nicole_demara.name: Nicole Demara
nicole_demara.text: Got a gig that pays well? Count me in.

soukaku.name: Soukaku
soukaku.text: Hehehe! Soukaku, reporting in! A pleasure to meet you!

ben_bigger.name: Ben Bigger
ben_bigger.text: Just call me Ben. Or Big Ben. I'll protect everyone.

caesar_king.name: Caesar King
caesar_king.text: I'm Caesar. The leader of the Sons of Calydon.

pan_yinhu.name: Pan Yinhu
pan_yinhu.text: Yunkui Summit disciple, Pan Yinhu, is honored to meet you.

seth_lowell.name: Seth Lowell
seth_lowell.text: Officer Seth, Lynx Thiren. Nice to meet you!

zhao.name: Zhao
zhao.text: Pleasure doing business. I'm Zhao from Krampus. Just call me Xiao'Zhao.
